title: Momcozy 3-Layers Large Capacity Bottle Sterilizer and Dryer, Pump Part Mode
bullets: 3-Layer Extra-Large Capacit: Momcozy Bottle Sterilizer and Dryer can accommodate up to 6-12 baby bottles, along with lots of breast pump parts, pacifiers, and teethers etc. Its spacious 3-layer design allows you to sterilize all your baby essentials at once.
Fast Sterilize and Dry: Powerful steam sterilize can kills 99.9% of harmful substance in just 9 minutes, then automatically dries with your choice timer of 10-60 minutes.

Stay Sterilized for 24 Hours: It will maintain a sterile storage state for up to 24 hours after drying. With ventilation and drying performed every 55 minutes, without worrying about contamination, ready to use.

Holders Designed for Breast Pump Parts: This baby bottle sterilizer features a sterilizing and drying mode specifically designed for breast pump accessories. The dedicated stand for the accessories can hold any brand pump parts, ensuring a 99.99% sterilization and drying effect.

Multifunctional sterilizer: It's not only just a sterilizer and dryer, but also a great storage solution for baby products. HEPA filter can provides clean air. Momcozy baby bottle sterilizer have features automatic shutdown and memory function, making it easy to use.
